purpose: Retain full per-token capability-cake semantics while accelerating the two profiler-identified route-selected cake matrix multiplies that escaped the original ONNX dynamic quantizer.

locked_source.native_functional_quality: PASS 1,400/1,400 on the earlier exact unquantized cake lineage
locked_source.native_general_quality: PyTorch host PASS with 0.9926431 parent top-1 agreement

triggering_evidence.finding: Physically skipping the cake increased sustained throughput above the gate but broke six functional families. Therefore the cake must remain active, and its two FP32 gathered-weight MatMul nodes are the bounded performance target.

single_allowed_change.down_projection: Quantize each installed route's 64 output channels independently to signed int8.
single_allowed_change.up_projection: Quantize each installed route's 768 output channels independently to signed int8.
single_allowed_change.activation: Use ONNX DynamicQuantizeLinear per active call, MatMulInteger, int32 cast, and exact recorded activation/weight scales.
single_allowed_change.selection: Gather exactly one route's int8 weight tensor and scale vector before each matrix multiply.

screen_order: Run a held-out active-logit/top-1 diagnostic against v30 on non-final search material.
Run all 1,400 native functional observations; any regression rejects the artifact.
Run all 420/43,089 held-out native general observations; require at least 0.95 parent agreement.
Only then run the unchanged sustained and headline CPU benchmarks.
promotion: The exact int8-cake graph must pass every quality, speed, TTFT, RSS, identity, physical, adversarial, and three-seed gate.
failure: Preserve and close this quantization architecture. Do not sweep quantization scales or bit widths.
